name: scroll-world
description: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed 'fly through the world' landing page for any industry or brand. As the visitor scrolls, a pre-rendered camera flies from outside each scene into its interior, then flows on to the next scene with no cuts — one continuous connected flight. Interviews the user for the topic, story beats, and brand kit, then generates cohesive scenes + seamless camera clips (Seedance 2.0 on Monid, fal.ai, or Higgsfield — your choice of biller) and wires a portable, framework-agnostic scroll-scrub engine. Use for a '3D world' / 'browse-through-the-industry' hero, a scroll cinematic, or a diorama landing.
